title: feat: add Claude Opus 5.5 via Bedrock
author: tomdacatto
pr_body_excerpt:
Fixes #15316

- Adds `anthropic/claude-opus-5.5` via the tested Bedrock `global.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5` profile, with a pinned OpenRouter Anthropic fallback.
- Uses the model's always-on adaptive thinking contract; forced tool selection is not advertised. Keeps text, image, auto tools, and 1M context / 128K output support.
- Sets primary cost to $4 input / $0.20 cache read / $5 cache write / $20 output per million tokens, without the OpenRouter fee. AWS's public price list has not yet published this launch-day entry; confirm it before merging.
- Verified local Gen → gateway → Bedrock text, auto tools, streaming with terminal usage, and cache write/hit; verified the OpenRouter fallback at default and high reasoning. Focused tests (140), lint/build, Gen CI, and Enter CI pass.
- Direct Azure Foundry's published global price is below OpenRouter's effective price, but a usable deployment/credential has not been verified; switch the fallback when it is.

Related: #5321

Original submission generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code).
